title: Fix image upload error and share function on HKLO blog

requirements.summary: Fix image upload failure by implementing aggressive canvas-based compression in useImageUpload.ts to resize images to max 1200px, compress to JPEG at quality 0.6, and enforce 800 KB limit before submission
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a large photo (e.g. a standard smartphone photo) compresses it below 800 KB before submission
Post creation succeeds with a compressed image without showing the error message
If an image cannot be compressed below 800 KB, a user-facing error in Swedish is shown before submission
Image preview is shown after compression, not the original file

file_operations.description: Replace the current image handling logic with aggressive canvas-based compression. Implement a multi-step compression function that: (1) loads the image into a canvas element, (2) calculates dimensions to resize the longest side to max 1200px while preserving aspect ratio, (3) draws the resized image on canvas, (4) exports to JPEG at quality 0.6 using canvas.toBlob, (5) checks if the resulting blob exceeds 800 KB and if so, sets a Swedish error message ('Bilden är fortfarande för stor efter komprimering. Max 800 KB tillåts.') in the hook's error state, (6) converts the compressed blob to Uint8Array for preview and backend submission. Update the preview URL generation to use the compressed blob instead of the original file. Expose the error state so CreatePostPage and EditPostPage can display it.

Display the image compression error from useImageUpload hook when present. Add a user-facing error message in Swedish below the image upload section that shows when an image exceeds the 800 KB limit after compression. Ensure the 'Skapa inlägg' button is disabled when there is an image size error. Clear the error when the user removes the problematic image.

requirements.summary: Fix share function to copy canonical post URL to clipboard and display Swedish confirmation toast
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the share button on a PostCard copies the correct post URL to the clipboard
Clicking the share button on the PostDetailPage copies the correct post URL to the clipboard
A Swedish confirmation message 'Länk kopierad!' appears briefly after copying
The function does not throw an uncaught error in any supported browser

file_operations.description: Implement the share button click handler to copy the canonical post URL (https://hkloblogg-nav.caffeine.xyz/post/{post.id}) to the clipboard using navigator.clipboard.writeText(). On successful copy, display a brief toast/tooltip with the Swedish text 'Länk kopierad!' that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds. If the Clipboard API is unavailable or the copy fails, fall back to showing a browser prompt with the URL using window.prompt(). Wrap the clipboard operation in a try-catch block to handle errors gracefully without throwing uncaught exceptions.
